item.title: Jamestown Results: Voters Approve $3 Million Housing Bond
item.description: Question 6 passes with about 59 percent, and voters fill five Town Council seats in a race where the last seat was decided by 34 votes.

item.title: Today on the Island: Jazz, Photography and a Lecture
item.description: RI Jazz Collective plays the Narragansett Café at 6 p.m., the Arts Center shows Family of Man at 6, and the library hosts an 18th-century talk at 6:30.

item.title: Jamestown Votes Today on $3 Million Housing Bond and Town Leadership
item.description: Question 6 asks whether the town may borrow up to $3 million for affordable housing, as voters also pick five councilors, two School Committee members and the moderator.

item.title: Tree Lighting and Concert Dec. 5 Caps the Holiday Stroll
item.description: The island lights its Christmas tree at 5:30 p.m. at the Recreation Center, the same day Santa arrives by boat.

item.title: Santa and Mrs. Claus to Arrive by Sea for Jamestown's Village Holiday Stroll
item.description: The Coastal Queen docks at East Ferry Wharf at 1 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 5, then a fire truck carries them to the Conanicut Gift Shop.

item.title: Italian Wannabe Brings a Story of Food, Love and Starting Over to Jamestown
item.description: A one-night screening at the Jamestown Arts Center, 18 Valley Street, Saturday, Nov. 7, at 7 p.m.; doors at 6:30.

item.title: From Ocean Racing Champion to Acclaimed Photographer: Onne van der Wal Comes to Jamestown
item.description: The marine photographer presents “The Family of Man” at the Jamestown Arts Center, 18 Valley Street, Wednesday, Nov. 4, 6 to 7 p.m.

item.title: Imprint and Playback at the Jamestown Arts Center, Through Nov. 7
item.description: Seven RISD Movement Lab fellows show motion-capture, augmented-reality and sound work at 18 Valley Street, Jamestown, through Nov. 7.

item.title: Classical Christmas with Frisson, a Short Drive Over the Bridge
item.description: Newport Classical presents an 11-piece chamber orchestra on Saturday, Dec. 12, at 1 and 3:30 p.m., at Emmanuel Church, Newport.

item.title: This Week on the Island: Jazz, Cooking Classes and a Movie Night
item.description: Live music four nights at the Narragansett Cafe, hands-on cooking at the Jamestown Arts Center and a screening to close the week, Nov. 1 to 8.

item.title: Sunday at the Narragansett Cafe: The Senders
item.description: Rhode Island's dance-rock favorites since 1983 play 25 Narragansett Ave., Jamestown, on Sunday, Nov. 1, 3 to 7 p.m. Band: thesenders.com · Cafe: narragansettcaferi.com

item.title: November at the Narragansett Cafe: A Band Almost Every Night
item.description: The Senders, 3 Wheelin, Deep End, the Strumdawgs, Jury Band and Don't Think Twice lead a packed month at 25 Narragansett Ave.

item.title: Jamestown Community Chorus Sings 'A Contemporary Christmas'
item.description: Two December concerts at the Recreation Center, Dec. 12 at 4 p.m. and Dec. 13 at 3 p.m., with mostly 21st-century music.

item.title: The Everybody Chorus Is Rockin' the '70s. Anyone Can Join
item.description: No auditions, all ages, Saturday mornings at the Recreation Center, and the money for music books goes to charity.

item.title: Santa Arrives by Boat Dec. 5 for the Jamestown Holiday Stroll
item.description: The Coastal Queen docks at East Ferry at 1 p.m., then Santa and Mrs. Claus ride a fire truck to the Conanicut Gift Shop for photos.

item.title: Off-Season on the Island: Ferry's Done, Here's What's Open
item.description: The Jamestown Newport Ferry and the town's museum and windmill closed for the season Oct. 12. Here's what's open and how fall cleanup works.

item.title: Thanksgiving on the Island: How to Help Jamestown's Food Pantries
item.description: The Community Food Pantry and St. Mark's pantry are open through the holidays. Here's what they need and when to drop it off.

item.title: November at the Library: LEGO, Storytime, Movies and a Writing Workshop
item.description: What's on at the Jamestown Philomenian Library, 26 North Road, for kids, teens and grown-ups.

item.title: Last Call for Golf on Conanicus Avenue: Season Runs Through November
item.description: The Jamestown Golf Course's season runs April through the end of November, so there are still a few weeks to play the nine holes by the bay.

item.title: Last Chance: 'Imprint and Playback' Closes Nov. 7 at the Arts Center
item.description: Seven artists from RISD's Movement Lab fill the Jamestown Arts Center with motion capture, sound and hand-tracked animation.

item.title: Seal Season Is Almost Here: Where to See Harbor Seals This Winter
item.description: Rhode Island's state marine mammal returns to the bay for the cold months, and Save The Bay's seal tours run November through April.

item.title: Halloween in Jamestown: Will Your Costume Keep You Warm?
item.description: Saturday looks sunny and dry, but the evening drops into the upper 40s. Here's the hour-by-hour forecast, this year's top costumes and how warm they'll keep you.

item.title: What Should You Hand Out This Halloween? A Jamestown Guide to Treats
item.description: The candies Rhode Island buys most, lower-sugar ideas and the teal pumpkin treats that let kids with food allergies join in.

item.title: Four Days of Live Music at the Narragansett Cafe
item.description: Megan Chenot tonight, the King Vintage Band Friday, the Smokin' Toads' Halloween party Saturday and the Senders Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Harlem's Cultural Giants Return to the Screen at the Jamestown Arts Center
item.description: newportFILM's screening of Once Upon a Time in Harlem tonight is sold out. Here's the story behind the film, and what's next at the Arts Center.

item.title: Halloween Night in Jamestown: What to Expect
item.description: The costume parade, the fire department's foam pit and the trick-or-treat streets around Green Lane. Here's how the island does it, and what to know for Saturday.

item.title: Halloween Weekend on the Island
item.description: Live music three nights at the Narragansett Cafe, a sing-along, a film, a pumpkin vote at the library, and clocks that fall back Sunday.

item.title: Sinatra by Candlelight at Central Baptist Church
item.description: A string trio plays Come Fly with Me and Strangers in the Night in two candlelit shows on Nov. 21.

item.title: End of an Era: Island Rubbish Is Sold
item.description: The Teixeira family is selling the island's longtime trash hauler to Eastern Waste Services, and the town's contract goes with it.

item.title: Senior Center Heads Home to West Street
item.description: Senior services move back into the renovated building in early November, and a Nov. 2 hearing could open the door to a north-end fire station.
